page.headline: Meet across borders.
page.subtext: Plan the trip, see who viewed and sparked you, and say hello before you land. Verification and matched messaging stay free for everyone.
page.banner1: See who viewed and sparked you
page.cellTravel: Visiting badge on Discover and Profile
page.cellPlusCountry: Pick a country: 11 Southeast Asian or 10 Western
page.cellBadge: Plus badge on profile and cards
page.faqA1: Yes. Selfie and location verification are free for every member, always. Verified profiles keep the community safe, so they are never behind a paywall.
page.faqQ2: What does the travel notice do?
page.faqA2: Add up to 3 upcoming trips in Profile, each up to 90 days, in any of the {n} hub cities. A Visiting badge then shows on your Discover card and profile so members there can say hello before you land.
page.faqA3: No. Women see who sparked and viewed them for free, and message without limits. Plus adds unlimited Sparks, the travel notice, filters, read receipts and the Plus badge for anyone who wants them.
page.faqQ4: What happens to my matches if I stop paying?
page.faqA4: Nothing is deleted. Your matches and conversations stay; only the Plus extras switch off at the end of the period you paid for.
page.billing1: Prices are in US dollars and are charged by Stripe. Taxes may apply.
page.billing2: 1 Month renews every month at {p1}. 3 Months renews at {p3} every 3 months. 6 Months renews at {p6} every 6 months.
page.billing3: Plans renew automatically until you cancel. Cancel any time in Settings, under Manage Subscription; you keep Plus until the end of the paid period.
page.billing4: Unlimited Sparks are subject to fair use to stop automated spam.
page.paymentsSoon: Payments are being configured. Please check back shortly.
page.activeBody: Thank you for supporting Meet in Asia. Manage billing or cancel any time.
